name: 戴榮冠
objective:
This course is designed for international students with a Chinese proficiency level of A1. The course revolves around everyday life scenarios, guiding students to understand Taiwanese society, culture, and related life themes through text reading, topical discussions, classroom activities, and cultural experiences, helping them build a basic understanding of local culture.

The course content includes individual and group reports, cultural experience activities, and cultural experience worksheets. Students will learn relevant Chinese vocabulary and expressions through active participation and observation, and record, organize, and reflect on what they have learned through the worksheets. The course also includes assignments and diverse classroom exercises, providing ample opportunities for students to practice listening, speaking, reading, and writing, aiming to comprehensively improve their Chinese communication skills and intercultural understanding.
schedule:
Week 1  | Course Introduction: goals, assessment, cultural experiences, worksheets, and use of generative AI                         
Week 2  | Self-Introduction and Daily Greetings: name, nationality, school, hobbies, and basic polite expressions                    
Week 3  | Campus Life and Learning Environment: classroom language, campus locations, and student life in Taiwan and Japan           
Week 4  | Cultural Comparison: Daily Life, Food Habits, Schedules, and Lifestyle Differences between Taiwan and Japan                
Week 5  | Cultural Experience: Taiwanese Food and Ordering Practice, with a Cultural Experience Worksheet                            
Week 6  | Using Generative AI for Chinese Learning: ChatGPT and Gemini for vocabulary, sentence practice, and report planning        
Week 7  | Transportation and City Life: asking for directions, taking public transportation, and comparing urban manners             
Week 8  | Cultural Experience: Taiwanese Tea Culture and Tea Tasting, with a Cultural Experience Worksheet                           
Week 9  | Midterm Group Presentation: Comparing Taiwanese and Japanese Culture in Simple Chinese                                     
Week 10 | Festivals and Family Culture: Taiwanese Festivals, Japanese Festivals, Family Terms, and Blessing Expressions              
Week 11 | Cultural Experience: Traditional Artifacts, Folk Objects, and Craft Activities, with a Cultural Experience Worksheet       
Week 12 | Shopping and Market Culture: prices, quantities, preferences, night markets, and shopping streets                          
Week 13 | Cultural Experience: Temple Culture, Worship Etiquette, and Religious Practices, with a Cultural Experience Worksheet      
Week 14 | Social Interaction and Politeness Culture: invitations, thanks, apologies, refusals, and Taiwan-Japan etiquette comparison 
Week 15 | Individual Chinese Learning Report Writing I: organizing worksheets, textbook content, and AI-assisted first draft writing 
Week 16 | Individual Chinese Learning Report Writing II: revising vocabulary, sentence patterns, paragraphs, and cultural comparison 
Week 17 | Final Individual Presentation: Chinese Learning Results, Cultural Experience Reflections, and Taiwan-Japan Comparison      
Week 18 | Course Review and Learning Reflection: AI Use, Cultural Experience, and Future Chinese Learning Goals
scorePolicy:
1. Individual and group reports: 40%
2. Worksheets: 40%
3. Class attendance: 20%

remarks: This course is designed for international students at the A1 Chinese level. It integrates Chinese language materials, daily-life topics, Taiwanese culture, and generative AI tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini.Through reading, discussion, classroom activities, assignments, and cultural experiences, students will learn about Taiwanese society and culture while improving their listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills.
